title: An advanced nomogram model using deep learning radiomics and clinical data for predicting occult lymph node metastasis in lung adenocarcinoma.
summary: The full text confirms a two-hospital cohort of 473 stage-IA lung adenocarcinoma cases, a fixed 404/69 train/test split, ResNet50 deep-transfer features and logistic models; the test-set DTL-radiomics and nomogram AUCs were 0.885 and 0.898.
ai_technology: ResNet50 transfer learning extracted CT radiomic features that logistic models combined with clinical variables to predict occult lymph-node metastasis.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The full text confirms a two-hospital cohort of 473 stage-IA lung adenocarcinoma cases, a fixed 404/69 train/test split, ResNet50 deep-transfer features and logistic models; the test-set DTL-radiomics and nomogram AUCs were 0.885 and 0.898.
evidence.unknown: The fixed 404/69 split comes from two hospitals and stage-IA cases; prospective utility or benefit from changing surgical management was not tested.
